turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is… it is all prepared as you wished, my dear. I have seen to it myself, every detail, so that you may rest easy and know that your wishes are honored. May the ancestors be pleased with this celebration, and with us all.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, you will ensure this maid understands her place. It is not enough that she serves me well now; she must continue to do so for your sake, and the sake of our lineage. See to it that she remembers her obligations, Wang Lung.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I understand your wishes and will ensure she is...properly instructed. It is my duty.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid possesses a certain diligence, I will concede that. But diligence alone does not guarantee strength, nor wisdom. See that she cultivates both, for the lineage demands more than mere competence.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She will, Mother. I will speak with her and ensure she understands the importance of these things. It is… a great responsibility.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Indeed, my son, you are wise to understand these things. It is a great weight, this responsibility for the family, and I am thankful you take it so seriously. We all must do our part to honor our ancestors and secure the future, mustn't we?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I trust she is capable of learning what is necessary. It is important that she understands.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son speaks of responsibility, and your father echoes his sentiment. It is not merely a weight to be borne, but a legacy to be shaped. See that she understands that her actions reflect upon all who came before, and all who will follow.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, a legacy… it is a powerful thing, isn't it? My son and I, we both want what is best for the family, and it is good to hear you speak of these things. We all strive to do our duty, and may the ancestors look kindly upon us.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She will, Mother. I will make certain she appreciates the significance of it all. It is… good to have these things settled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of duty, and your son of responsibility. These are words, yes, but words without action are like seeds that fall on barren ground. Ensure she understands not merely the *doing*, but the *why* of it all, for the legacy is not merely in possessions, but in character.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will impress upon her the importance of… of everything you’ve said. It will be done.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Indeed, the *why*... it is very important, isn't it? I trust my son will relay all of this… and I hope she listens well, for a family’s strength comes from understanding, you see. We all want the best for her, and for the continuation of our line.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father and son speak of understanding, but understanding without diligence is a fleeting thing. I trust you will ensure this maid comprehends not only the duties she will perform, but the *weight* of them; for a woman's role is not merely to serve, but to *be* the foundation of a family's endurance.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I will see to it that she understands the… the importance of her role. It is my duty to ensure that.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father and son concern themselves with the external, the visible. But I have observed, over these many years, that strength is not merely *said*, but *lived*. See to it, eldest son, that she understands that the endurance of our line is not found in pronouncements, but in quiet, unwavering perseverance.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She will, Mother. I will remind her of your words, and ensure she strives for that… that quiet strength. It will be well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son assures me she will strive for this 'quiet strength,' but words are wind. I require more than assurances; I require *evidence* of it. See to it that she understands that my legacy, and yours, will be judged not by what is *said*, but by what *endures*.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I will observe her, and ensure she demonstrates that… that perseverance you speak of. It is my responsibility to uphold the family’s standing.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is a good thing, eldest son, that you will watch her closely. I trust you will guide her well, and remind her of your mother’s wisdom; such things are important for a woman to hear, and for all of us to remember.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
